# LokaYantra

> LokaYantra is a free browser-based HTML5 gaming platform. Play thousands of instant-play games — action, racing, puzzle, adventure, sports, shooting, arcade, simulation, brain, battle, and IO games — with no downloads or installs required.

## Site

- [Home](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/): Browse the full games catalogue and featured collections.
- [All Categories](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/categories): Full list of game categories.
- [Trending Games](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/trending): Currently popular games.
- [New Releases](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/new-releases): Recently added games.
- [About](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/about): About LokaYantra.
- [Contact](https://lokayantra.vercel.app/contact): Contact the LokaYantra team.
